description: A leaf with the date and nothing else

participation.context: Wrote the date only, and did not go on.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the letter is still unsent, and this leaf is not a letter

story.body: You put the day on the leaf and did not follow it with a line. You left the comedy shut.

relations.note: the letter is still unsent, and this leaf is not a letter

title: Wrote the date on the leaf

participation.context: Spoke the memo alone, by one candle, and did not write.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the night prayer is known and not said

story.body: You said you did not go to the hanging. You refused a likeness with the play. You left your father's prayer unsaid. You reminded yourself about the messenger, found the pen empty, and stopped at Enough.

relations.note: the night prayer is known and not said

title: Said Southwell was hanged and refused a likeness with the play
